subject: NeuroWave cohort billing: startup credits, first-month overage relief request
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@neustart.io>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Startup cohort billing question / brief spike in usage

Hi Hannah,

Quick note from our side — we're onboarding 12 teams from the NeuroWave accelerator this week and a handful of them are running high-throughput embedding jobs as they ingest telemetry. We expected some ramp but are seeing a short spike that will push the cohort past the promo credits Redwood offered for the accelerator.

Before we start scaling everyone down, wanted to check two things:
- Is there any flexibility on the one-time promo credits or a short "overage relief" you can provide for the first 30 days while teams stabilize?
- If not, can we get a recommended mitigations list (batching settings, model variants) that we can apply quickly?

Attached is a rough usage snapshot (pilot_usage_estimate.pdf). We're on a tight timeline with Demo Day next month and this spike is mostly a front-loaded ingestion run.

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if it's easier.

Best,
Alice Nguyen
Program Lead, NeuroWave Labs
alice@neustart.io
+1 415-555-0182

--
NeuroWave Labs — accelerator for applied neuroscience startups

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@neustart.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 30 May 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Startup cohort billing question / brief spike in usage

Thanks for the note and for the usage file, Alice — this is exactly the kind of scenario our startup programs encounter. Short answer: we can do a limited, one-time ramp relief for accelerated cohorts, with a small approval path.

Proposal (high level):
- One-time "ramp relief" credit pool of $5,000 applied to the cohort's account to cover first-month overages.
- If usage remains elevated into month 2, we can provide a one-time 50% discount on overage invoices for month 2 only (conditional on a signed mutual action plan).
- We will send an MA plan draft and a usage-forecast template so your engineers can signal when to switch to lower-cost model variants or enable batching.

Next steps from our side: Marissa (cc'd) will attach the draft MA and a usage-forecast template. If acceptable, sign the MOU (DocuSign) and route a PO to accounting@redwood.com so we can put the credits on the account and configure the discount.

I've attached: MA-plan-draft.docx and usage-forecast-template.xlsx. If you want, we can do a quick 20-minute call today to walk engineering through the easy mitigation knobs (batching, smaller model checkpoints).

Cheers,
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Startup Programs | Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
(650) 555-0123

Can you weigh in so I can confirm to them? If approved, I'll request Finance to provision the credit and Marissa can send the DocuSign link.
